summary: Portal KB Integration testing complete. All backend API and frontend tests pass. kb_group_key field verified in categories, admin KB endpoints work with auth, Linked KB Topic dropdown shows 5 nav groups, Help Articles section fetches from dynamic API.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing portal categories and KB data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portal KB Integration feature fully tested. Categories now have kb_group_key field from DB, admin can link categories to KB topics via dropdown. Test user: test@emergent.sh with session_token=test_kb_session_token. Admin endpoints require this session cookie. Credits-pricing category has kb_group_key='beginners-guide' which shows articles from beginners-guide KB group in Related Documentation section.

portal_categories_kb_group_key.details: GET /api/portal/categories returns all categories with kb_group_key field. Credits-pricing has kb_group_key='beginners-guide'.

admin_kb_nav_groups.details: GET /api/portal/admin/kb-nav-groups returns 5 KB nav groups (beginners-guide, features, building-your-app, deploy-and-manage, troubleshooting). Requires admin auth.

admin_kb_articles_list.details: GET /api/portal/admin/kb-articles-list returns 49 published KB articles with slug and title. Requires admin auth.

admin_create_category_kb_group.details: POST /api/portal/admin/categories creates category with kb_group_key field.

help_topics_icon_description.details: GET /api/portal/help-topics returns topics with icon and description fields using stored metadata + fallback defaults.

portal_home_categories_grid.details: Portal home (/portal) shows categories grid with titles, descriptions, icons, and topic counts from DB.

portal_category_related_docs.details: /portal/category/credits-pricing shows Related Documentation section with articles from beginners-guide KB group (fetched via category.kb_group_key from API).

admin_linked_kb_topic_dropdown.details: Admin category form shows Linked KB Topic dropdown with 6 options (None + 5 KB nav groups).

admin_dynamic_kb_articles.details: Help Articles section in admin form shows dynamic KB articles list (49 articles from API, not hardcoded).
